text: Hello, this is Liam in for Bear. This film shows how to organize a humanitarian's AI fellows folder. Keep the first name and last initial naming convention. Your job is to organize the record so another person can follow your contribution, your reasoning, and your actual work. How does my folder make my work easy to verify?
